The '''Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade''' was a religious [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusade]] launched by the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the [[Zarracine]]s of [[Zarracina III]] and the [[Teirasan]]s of the [[Teirasa system/Legends|Teirasa system]] that occurred in [[11,660 BBY]]. The crusade ended with a Republic bombardment of Zarracina III and the near extinction of the Zarracine species.

==The crusade==
When the planet [[Zarracina III]] was discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[11,660 BBY]], the Republic forces attempted to conquer the native [[Zarracine]]s. However, the Zarracines resisted the [[Pius Dea]]-controlled government's attempt, and in response the Republic [[Bombardment of Zarracina III|bombarded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. The attack drove the Zarracines to extinction and irradiated the planet's surface, destroying all life.<ref name="Tinker" />

The Republic forces also launched an attack against the [[Teirasan]]s of the [[Teirasa system/Legends|Teirasa system]] from [[Ord Dorlass]] and [[Ord Zynthar]], battling the Teirasans to an unknown outcome.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The destruction of Zarracina III, part of the Twelfth Pius Dea Crusade, first appeared in the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace.com]]-exclusive story ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]''.<ref name="Tinker" /> The crusade was further expanded upon in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.<ref name="EGW" />
